source: BK6 printed pp.51-52 = book5-6.pdf PDF pp.57-58 (wires p.51 = PDF p.57, procedure p.52 = PDF p.58), image-read; ERRATA sheet p.4 (errata.pdf PDF p.4) ER-40 re-set by power cycle; Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect is derived by hand from the 74-wire topology (VI-SEQREC's 38 basic lines then the 36 Secret Code additions, programs.json wiresEffective, identical to the printed fixture's wires) and the p.52 rule (light 1 = code solved, light 6 = error and automatic re-set), and is tagged FALLBACK-DERIVED-TOPOLOGY. Each pushbutton reaches one COMMON terminal through two slide switches; with all six RIGHT pushbutton n reaches ncom (the printed code 6 through 1), with all six LEFT the derived code is 4-1-2-5-6-3. Relay n+1's set-2 arm passes (n)com to relay n's coil only once relay n+1 is in; otherwise that arm rests on the N bus tied to 6E, and + there shorts relay 6's latched coil, which drops the chain (the automatic re-set). Asserted: the idle state at power-on and after the ER-40 power cycle (light 6 lit, light 1 dark, all relays out), light 6 out after the first correct push, light 1 dark one push short of solved, the solved state, the full re-set after an error with two relays latched (6, 5, then 3), and the second switch setting (6 first now does nothing; 4-1-2-5-6-3 solves). Indicator lamps are asserted only dark: a lit indicator lamp is in series with its coil and its class is profile-dependent. No state is asserted while a pushbutton is held. Script choices, not printed: the wrong press (3 after 6, 5), the second setting (all LEFT), and each push as press, settle 500 ms, release, settle 500 ms. Two 200 ms waits follow the settles before the indicator checks at steps 56 and 69: settle returns after 20 quiet ticks while a filament is still cooling through dim (architecture section 13.5, O-E12).
